metadata.title: SURAT  Food Tour | Part - 1 I Gujarat Food Tour I Indian Street Food
metadata.description:
The culture of Surat has shaped over time as people have migrated from diverse backgrounds into the city. People from various communities like Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, Parsi,Burmese, Christian are collectively known as the Surtis. 

In this episode, we explored the Old Surat- Zampa Bazar and tried the authentic surati delicacies. Watch the whole video to experience the local cuisine of Surat.

A big thanks to Urvi ben, Rohan bhai and Basit bhai for introducing us to the local surti cuisine. 

About the host- Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
